name: TC-03-work-schedule-holiday
description: TC-03.4: Work Schedule & Holiday — Create work schedule and holiday records

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Work Schedule List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Schedule. Work schedules define standard working hours, shifts, and availability for maintenance planning.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — New Work Schedule
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a work schedule. Define the schedule name, working days, and shift hours.

steps.target: input[name='schedule_name'], textarea[name='schedule_name'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name'], input[name='description'], textarea[name='description']

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Fill Schedule Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Standard 5-Day Schedule" into the Schedule Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Work Schedule Created
doc_metadata.caption: The work schedule is saved and can be linked to employees, sites, and maintenance planning calendars.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Work Schedule Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The work schedule detail shows the schedule name, working days, shift times, and associated resources.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Holiday List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Holiday. Holidays define non-working days that affect SLA calculations and maintenance scheduling.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — New Holiday
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a holiday entry. Specify the holiday name and date.

steps.target: input[name='holiday_name'], textarea[name='holiday_name'], input[name='name'], textarea[name='name'], input[name='description'], textarea[name='description']

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Fill Holiday Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test Holiday" into the Holiday Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Holiday Created
doc_metadata.caption: The holiday is saved and will be excluded from SLA calculations and work day computations.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.4 — Holiday Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The holiday detail shows the name, date, and associated work schedules affected by this holiday.
